title: Coronary Artery Ligation in Mice
author: Richard Mcindoe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wc4fayw
materials: Shave the left thoracic area of the mouse.

steps.title: Anesthetize and Prepare Mouse
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse and verify the depth of anesthesia using a toe pinch.

steps.title: Intubate and Position Mouse
steps.instruction: Intubate the mouse and secure it for surgery.

substeps.instruction: Place mouse on a rodent ventilator with the left chest up.
Secure feet to the surgical area with tape.

steps.title: Prepare Surgical Field
steps.instruction: Clean and drape the surgical area.

substeps.instruction: Prep the surgical field with 70% isopropanol and Betadine solution.

steps.title: Perform Left Side Thoracotomy
steps.instruction: Open the chest cavity to access the heart, taking care to avoid lung injury.

substeps.instruction: Perform a left side thoracotomy between the 3rd and 4th intercostal space.
Open the area approximately 6-7 mm using a small retractor.

steps.title: Ligate the LAD Artery
steps.instruction: Identify the left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery using a microscope and place a 7-0 Proline suture under the artery without entering the left ventricle.

substeps.instruction: Determine suture placement based on desired infarction size: 2 mm below the left atrium for 'large', 3 mm for 'medium', or 4 mm for 'small'.
For acute ischemia: Tie the suture permanently.
For ischemia reperfusion: Secure the suture over a 3-4 mm piece of PE-90 tubing for 30 minutes, then remove the suture to facilitate reperfusion.

steps.title: Close the Rib Cage
steps.instruction: Close the thoracic cavity while leaving a port for air evacuation.

substeps.instruction: Place two separate 6-0 Proline sutures to close the rib cage.
Leave a 20g iv catheter sheath between the sutures.

steps.title: Close the Dermis
steps.instruction: Suture the skin closed using 6-0 Proline, tissue clips, or surgical glue.

steps.title: Evacuate Thoracic Air
steps.instruction: Remove air from the thoracic cavity using the 20g iv catheter sheath and a 1-mL syringe.

substeps.instruction: Gently pinch the skin around the sheath.
Slowly draw back on the syringe while withdrawing the sheath.

steps.title: Recovery and Extubation
steps.instruction: Wean the animal off anesthesia and extubate once spontaneous breathing resumes.

steps.title: Post-Operative Hydration
steps.instruction: Inject 0.5 ml of 0.9% NaCl subcutaneously to each mouse to prevent dehydration.

steps.title: Post-Procedure Care and Monitoring
steps.instruction: Administer analgesics and monitor the mice post-operatively.

substeps.instruction: Administer Buprenorphine (0.05mg/kg) every 12 hours for 72 hours.
Administer Meloxicam (5mg/kg) every 24 hours for 72 hours.
Monitor mice 2x daily for the first 72 hours.
Monitor mice at least 3x per week thereafter.
